name: Held Breath
flavour: Plant your feet. Fill your lungs. Let them come.
text: Stand still 2 s before a breath: it lasts twice as long, hits ×1.5 and comes from all sides. A hit breaks the stillness.
vfx: a full ring of fire round the hero's head when he has stood still, twice as long
art_prompt: a ring of orange fire seen from above, flames licking outwards all the way round a calm dark centre
